assertions.assertion: Response configures ForwardedHeadersOptions with ForwardedHeaders including XForwardedProto to restore the original HTTPS scheme
assertions.rationale: It configures ForwardedHeadersOptions with ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedHost | ForwardedHeaders.XForwardedProto and states XForwardedProto restores the https scheme.

assertions.assertion: Response calls UseForwardedHeaders() early in the pipeline, before UseIdentityServer()
assertions.rationale: app.UseForwardedHeaders() is placed first, before UseIdentityServer(), with an explicit note that it must run early.

assertions.assertion: Response mentions the ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true environment variable as a simpler alternative for cloud/Kubernetes
assertions.rationale: Option 1 presents ASPNETCORE_FORWARDEDHEADERS_ENABLED=true as the simplest option for cloud/Kubernetes.

assertions.assertion: Response explains that the reverse proxy strips the original scheme and host headers, causing IdentityServer to generate HTTP URLs in discovery
assertions.rationale: The 'Why this happens' section explains the proxy strips the original scheme/host so IdentityServer emits http:// URLs in discovery.
